summary: This is your medication plan. It shows which medicines you take, and when. You take six medicines regularly. You take two of them only once a week. You can take Paracetamol when you have pain.
action_steps: Take your medicines at the times shown in your daily plan.
Take Methotrexat only on Mondays. Never take it every day.
Bring this plan to every doctor and to the pharmacy.

key_items.label: Bring this plan with you
key_items.value: zu jedem Arztbesuch und in die Apotheke
key_items.explanation: Show this plan to every doctor and at the pharmacy, so they know all your medicines.
key_items.source_quote: Bitte bringen Sie diesen Plan zu jedem Arztbesuch und in die Apotheke mit.

key_items.label: Your family doctor
key_items.explanation: Dr. Anna Schmidt made this plan. Call her if you have questions.

medications.name: Ramipril
medications.instructions: One tablet in the morning and one in the evening.

medications.name: Metformin
medications.instructions: Half a tablet in the morning and half in the evening, with food.
medications.source_quote: Metformin  1000 mg  Tabl.  ½  0  ½  0  zum Essen  Diabetes

medications.name: Methotrexat
medications.instructions: One tablet once a week, on Mondays only. Never every day.
medications.source_quote: Methotrexat  15 mg  Tabl.  1x wöchentlich montags  Rheuma

medications.name: Folsäure
medications.purpose: A vitamin that goes with Methotrexat.
medications.instructions: One tablet once a week, on Tuesdays.
medications.source_quote: Folsäure  5 mg  Tabl.  1x wöchentlich dienstags  zu Methotrexat

medications.name: Pantoprazol
medications.instructions: One tablet in the morning, before breakfast.
medications.source_quote: Pantoprazol  20 mg  Tabl.  1  0  0  0  vor dem Frühstück  Magenschutz

medications.name: Paracetamol
medications.purpose: For pain, only when you need it.
medications.instructions: One tablet when you have pain. At most 4 tablets a day.
medications.source_quote: Paracetamol  500 mg  Tabl.  bei Schmerzen, max. 4x täglich  Schmerzen
